_note: REBUILT FROM SCRATCH 2026-08-13 (SMITH-LEDGER run 2, G66b) by proper chronological FIFO simulation over the corrected trades.json (all 13 previously-quarantined 07-29/07-31 rows now email_confirmed, MU 07-29 qty corrected 1.003005->1 per the email's own Shares field, all qty_diff->qty_change normalized). Unlike the prior lots.json rebuild (which computed each ticker's predates-history dust as a single holdings-minus-net subtraction), this run simulates FIFO trade-by-trade: BUYs create lots, SELLs consume oldest-first, and any SELL that exhausts all dated lots draws the shortfall from an implicit predates-history pool -- exactly the tickers where the reconciled 07-24-to-08-12 sale had no cost basis in trades.json. This corrected several dust plugs that were understated (e.g. ASML's was wrongly showing ~1.15e-6 when the ticker's actual predates-history component is far larger; conversely NVDA/LRCX/COHR/etc. that fully round-tripped through a zero-crossing within trades.json's window correctly carry NO predates plug at all, since their current holdings are entirely funded by trades.json's own dated entries). 14 unknown-basis SELL events were identified this way -- these are EXCLUDED from realized P&L (the lot they drew on has price_usd=null) and are listed in the accompanying reconciliation report. Priority-2 full 2025-04-30 email pull was NOT completed this run (see report) -- these predates-history lots and the 14 unknown-basis sales remain exactly that: unknown, not fabricated. sum(lots)==holdings verified for all 31 held tickers.
